summary: Concord installs its agent definitions, skills, and an authored tool-agnostic conduct corpus once under the versioned data root, and a consuming project holds a pointer rather than a copy. The always-on instruction surface is registered per project so non-Concord projects receive nothing, while agents live in the central OpenCode agents directory because no per-project pointer exists and an agent is inert until invoked. skills/ stays reserved so CD-0043 D3 is preserved, methodology stays host-owned under CD-0043 D1, and a loaded corpus file binds by content hash in the CD-0034 provenance manifest.
title: Concord ships an always-on operator conduct corpus
